source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 1 同主题完形(我的第一次画展/学水墨画/参观博物馆的一天/收藏家的建议/做一名小雕塑家/谈一幅名画)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: My First Art Show
passages.text: Last month our class held a small art (1)____ in the school hall. For weeks, my biggest (2)____ had been how to begin my own painting. When visitors looked at my work, some of them gently (7)____ it, and their honest words helped me a lot. By the end of the day, I felt very (8)____ of what I had made. passages.title: A Day at the Museum
passages.text: On Saturday my friend and I spent a whole day at the city (1)____ of fine art. There was so much to see that our first (2)____ was simply where to start. passages.title: Advice from an Art Collector
passages.text: My uncle has collected paintings for many years, and he often gives me useful (1)____. He also tells me to look at a lot of (5)____ art by living painters, because some of it is also (6)____ of attention. Before buying, he always asks himself one simple (7)____: does this picture move me? If the answer is no, he walks (8)____. Over the years, his small collection has slowly (9)____ a fine reputation. Yet for him, the real (10)____ of collecting art is not money, but the joy each painting brings him every single day.

passages.title: Becoming a Young Sculptor

passages.text: In class today we talked about one of the most famous Chinese (1)____ in the world. It shows the busy life along a river during an old (2)____.
